note: Vendor PDFs are not committed (copyright); facts below are quoted/translated with section references. Evidence label: DOCUMENTED.

facts.ref: HW guide s1 block diagram; Table 2-5 title 'D213EC (Sip DDR3) QFN128'
facts.consequence: No external DDR routing for the D213. VCC_DRAM pins need 1.5 V (DDR3).

facts.quote: VDD11_SYS: 1.2 V @ CPU 600 MHz (DDR3 672 MHz), 1.1 V @ 504 MHz (DDR3 600 MHz); average <= 250 mA, size regulator >= 500 mA
facts.consequence: Dedicated 1.2 V buck, >= 500 mA, feedback sensed at the D213 decoupling capacitors (4.1 item 3).

facts.quote: VCC33_IO 3.3 V, average <= 100 mA, size >= 500 mA
VDDQ_DDR DDR3 1.5 V, average <= 150 mA, size >= 500 mA; internal LDO1x not recommended for DDR
LDO25_OUT, VCC30_ANA: 1 uF bypass only; LDO1x_OUT 1 uF
No power-up/down order requirement; VCC33_IO rise time > 150 us and < 5 ms
facts.consequence: 3V3 rail slew must be checked: 150 us .. 5 ms (soft-start of the 3V3 regulator).

facts.quote: 24 MHz crystal, < +-20 ppm; 0R in series on PLL_XO recommended
RTC crystal optional (pins may float); RTC_VCOIN may float (internal diode from VCC33_IO); 10M across XI/XO if used

Blank storage -> directly enters burn (USB) mode. Storage with firmware -> SDK default PA0 pulled low at power-up/reset enters burn mode (configurable in ddr_init.json). PA0 is also UART0_TX; it is sampled only at power-up/reset.
facts.consequence: F133 must be able to hold D213 PA0 low across a D213 reset (open-drain, series R so the UART0 debug TX is not loaded afterwards).

facts.quote: RESETN: internal ~30 k pull-up + debounce, active low; released ~7 ms after VCC33_IO > 2.5 V; low > 2 ms resets; external cap <= 4.7 uF
facts.consequence: F133 drives RESETN open-drain; reset pulse >= 2 ms (firmware); keep a reset button/jumper.

facts.quote: SPI0 on PB0-PB5 is the flash boot interface; NOR or NAND; 3.3 V only; CS/WP/HOLD must be pulled up; group length-matched within 40 mil; BROM 'try' produces ms pulses on PB0-PB5 CS/CMD/CLK
PRGB 24-bit default (config 0 RGB888, recommended); R and B groups may be swapped by software (data-order BGR); bit reversal only in RGB888 and all three groups together
facts.consequence: RGB888 on PD0-PD27 to the TFP410 is a documented configuration.

facts.quote: PE0 RXD1, PE1 RXD0, PE2 RXCTL, PE3 GMAC_CLKIN <- PHY_CLKOUT (125 MHz reference clock output), PE4 TXD1, PE5 TXD0, PE6 TXCK, PE7 TXCTL, PE8 MDC, PE9 MDIO, PE10 CLK_OUT 25 MHz, PE11 RXD3, PE12 RXD2, PE13 RXCK, PE14 TXD3, PE15 TXD2

facts.ref: User manual 12.2.3.4 'GMAC connects RGMII PHY (external clock): MAC uses external 125 MHz clock'
facts.quote: MAC 采用外部 125 MHz 时钟 (only RGMII clocking scheme documented)
facts.consequence: GAP FOUND 2026-10-16: the R10 plan had no source for GMAC0_CLKIN. The 45F must forward a 125 MHz clock to PE3 (decision D7).
